Saved copies of upstream pages and files, used only to test the parsers:

- `constant-*.md`: [teorth/optimizationproblems](https://github.com/teorth/optimizationproblems) at commit
  `87b4ebbd426f` (Terence Tao and contributors, Apache License 2.0).
- `erdos-*.lean`: [google-deepmind/formal-conjectures](https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures) at
  commit `2055e5adadae` (The Formal Conjectures Authors, Apache License 2.0).
- `erdos-problems.yaml`: the first entries of `data/problems.yaml` in
  [teorth/erdosproblems](https://github.com/teorth/erdosproblems) at commit `acb2d48c137b`.
- `covering-improvements.html`: the structure of the "Latest (v,k,t) improvements" page of
  [coveringrepository.com](https://www.coveringrepository.com), with three rows (8 November 2026).
